test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the underlined word in the following sentence.**

Darwin drew our attention to the gradual accumulation of __unfavourable__ traits and its direct relationship with the survival of those presumed lucky species, which then serve as breeding grounds for more desirable traits.
solution: The correct answer is: **Advantageous** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence talks about the relationship between unfavourable traits and the survival of species. • **Unfavourable **means something that is not advantageous or does not work in one's favour. (कुछ ऐसा जो लाभप्रद नहीं है या किसी के पक्ष में काम नहीं करता है) • ​**Example**: *The unfavourable weather conditions forced the cancellation of the outdoor event.* • ​Marked option **Advantageous **means something that is favourable or beneficial, providing an advantage or benefit. (कोई ऐसी चीज़ जो अनुकूल या लाभदायक हो, लाभ या लाभ प्रदान करती हो) • **Example**: *His strong communication skills proved advantageous in securing the job.* • The opposite of unfavourable is advantageous. • Therefore, the antonym of unfavourable is advantageous. Thus, **option 1** is the correct sentence. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Fulfilling **means satisfying or achieving one's goals. (किसी के लक्ष्य को संतुष्ट करना या प्राप्त करना) • **Steady **means stable or consistent. (स्थिर या सुसंगत) • **Negative **means not desirable or optimistic. (वांछनीय या आशावादी नहीं) 3f:T606, The correct answer is: **QPSR**.
